name: template-retarget-restart-decisions
body:
Template retarget requires restart [with user]. Decision: when the configured `templates:` value in `kalide.yaml` changes while `kalide start` runs, the server must stop serving the deck and show the standard kalide full-page error telling the user to restart `kalide start`; normal serving resumes only after a restart, or if the value is edited back to the value captured at startup. This replaces the previous behaviour, in which the reload pipeline re-resolved the configured path on every reload so a mid-session retarget was silently live-applied — a confusing half-state where the reload used the new root while the watcher kept watching the old one. The comparison baseline is the `templates:` value captured at `kalide start` startup (equivalently, the resolved root). Scope: only a change of the configured value; edits of files under the resolved root keep live-reloading, as do all other `kalide.yaml` keys and slides/assets changes. Local only: no network, no new embedded assets (global.constraint.anonymous-install, global.constraint.go-static-embedded-binary, global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets); library resolution and the watcher are not redesigned.

Amended/added authored nodes: requirements.requirement.template-retarget-requires-restart (new; feature project-templates); amended requirements.requirement.external-template-library, requirements.requirement.templates-live-reload, requirements.requirement.live-reload, requirements.requirement.deck-config, global.constraint.never-serve-broken-deck, domain.service.watch-deck, domain.entity.deck-changed, domain.service.load-template-library, domain.entity.template-library, solution.component.file-watcher, solution.component.http-server, solution.component.template-library-loader. New spine edges: contains (requirements.requirement.project-templates → requirements.requirement.template-retarget-requires-restart); drives (new requirement → domain.service.watch-deck, domain.service.load-template-library, domain.entity.template-library); realised-by (domain.service.watch-deck → solution.component.http-server); implemented-by (solution.component.http-server → the reloader path go.github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide/internal/server.Reloader, .loadLibrary, .renderDefault).

Implementation statements to correct (the plan's job, not this spec): internal/server/reload.go's loadLibrary doc says retargeting `templates:` is reflected on the next call, and internal/server/reload_external_test.go asserts a retargeted `templates:` is picked up without restart — both must state/assert the new restart-required error instead. e2e/livereload_test.go and any other statement implying a live retarget are corrected the same way.
